# KanjiVG attribution

The stroke paths and stroke-number positions in `kanjivg-strokes.js` are derived from [KanjiVG](https://kanjivg.tagaini.net/).

KanjiVG is copyright © 2009–2026 Ulrich Apel and contributors and is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).

The generated subset contains only the characters currently used by Kanji Garden. Run `tools/sync-kanjivg.mjs` after updating `kanji-data.js` to regenerate the subset and its coverage report.
